reason: I like being early, and the identity, human-approval and kill-switch layer is something our rate limits don't give me. But I'm not putting a proxy with no SOC 2 and no customers in front of live customer trades, and I won't sign a price LOI and be a reference just to get a free pilot.
objection: It sits inline on the order path. If it goes down or gets breached, my customers' trades stop or leak, and my vendor-risk team won't sign off on that without an audit. I'm also not sure the agents hitting our API carry AINRA passports at all, and per-action pricing is hard for me to budget.
would_change_my_mind: Let me run it in shadow mode on staging, logging decisions without blocking anything, with no LOI or reference required up front, plus a firm date for the SOC 2 Type I report.
